newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Iran envoy meets King Hassan over Islamic issues.
newsitem.headline: Iran envoy meets King Hassan over Islamic issues.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati on Monday met Morocco's King Hassan in Rabat to discuss bilateral ties and issues related to the Islamic Conference Organisation (ICO), a Moroccan official said.
"Velayati, who conferred with his Majesty King Hassan for more than one hour, delivered a message from Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani," the official said.
The meeting took place at the royal palace of Rabat, he added but gave no other details.
A diplomatic source said Iran, which in 1998 will take over the presidency of the ICO currently headed by Morocco, "is lobbying to improve its position inside the Islamic organisation."
Morocco is also the secretary general of the ICO.
Velayati, who arrived in Rabat on Sunday, told reporters at the airport: "While bilateral relations had seen an important improvement in recent years, Iran was ready to boost cooperation further."
Trade between the two countries is estimated at $300 million in 1996, officials said.
